propositions: The docs/releasing.md and .github/workflows/release.yml incorrectly describe the pypi environment approval as a second human interactive approval, when the actual mechanism requires only the configured release identity (JoeOakhartNava) to approve non-interactively via REST API

The pypi environment's required_reviewers rule permits self-review (prevent_self_review: false) and allows admin bypass (can_admins_bypass: true), so it does not provide independent second-party review as the documentation implies

The approval is executed non-interactively through the pending_deployments REST API with a JSON body specifying environment_ids as an integer array, not through an interactive GitHub UI prompt as the docs suggest
The runbook must document both the GET request to discover pending_deployments and the POST request to approve them, including proper JSON body formatting to avoid field-flag typing hazards
